Name: Muted Expanded Patch
Author: JaneAndTonicc
Description: I really like the style of the muted [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16777]seeds[/url]/[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16779]saplings[/url]/[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16780]fertilizers[/url] so I made a mod so you can have both and not have to have just a couple random items that don't fit the aesthetic. I reached out to the mod author for the muted series and got permission to post this mod, which used the assets of the bag and the sapling along with the assets of the icons for the fruit and veggies from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]expanded[/url]. I've pieced those together and done a bit of color shifting to make the fruit/veggies colors fit a more desaturated pallet and made this! I hope y'all enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Muted Expanded Pack
Manifest.Description: Item texture replacer for seeds and saplings to match the muted seeds and muted saplings mods.
Manifest.Author: JaneAndTonicc
